_comment: OpenSSF Best Practices self-assessment for Sinedrone-Sentinel/dumpers_repo (Passing + Silver + Gold + Baseline 1/2/3). Many Silver/Gold/Baseline-2/3 items are intentionally Unmet (solo maintainer, no CoC/GOVERNANCE yet, SignPath pending, no SBOM/assurance case). Open each section edit page and Save (and continue) robot; review highlights before accepting. Project: https://www.bestpractices.dev/en/projects/13989
name: dumpers_repo
description: Dumper's Repo — Star Citizen blueprint tracking, mining tools, resource coordination, member marketplace, and Dumper Apps (BP Dumper).
access_continuity_justification: Solo-maintainer project; no documented lockbox/will/second-admin continuity plan yet for issues/PRs/releases within a week of loss of one person.
accessibility_best_practices_justificati: No formal accessibility (WCAG) program documented yet for the SPA; keyboard/semantic improvements are ad hoc.
achieve_passing_justification: Passing metal badge not yet achieved (in progress). Prerequisite for Silver.
achieve_silver_justification: Silver badge not achieved; prerequisite unmet.
assurance_case_justification: No published assurance case (threat model + trust boundaries + secure-design argument) document yet.
automated_integration_testing_justificat: CI runs lint + npm test + build on every PR to main. https://github.com/Sinedrone-Sentinel/dumpers_repo/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
build_justification: Working build: npm ci && npm run build (Vite). Documented in README/CONTRIBUTING; CI builds every PR. https://github.com/Sinedrone-Sentinel/dumpers_repo/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
build_common_tools_justification: Node.js / npm / Vite are standard tools for this stack. Dumper Apps Windows packaging uses documented PowerShell + Inno Setup in CI.
build_floss_tools_justification: Site build uses FLOSS toolchain (Node, npm, Vite, TypeScript, ESLint). Python portions use CPython.
build_non_recursive_justification: N/A — Vite/npm build is not a recursive make-subdir native build with cross-dependencies of that form.
build_preserve_debug_justification: N/A — no POSIX install -s style native binary install system for the main products.
build_repeatable_justification: Bit-for-bit reproducible builds are not claimed/documented for site or DumperApps.exe yet.
build_reproducible_justification: Reproducible builds not documented/proven for DumperApps.exe or the Vite site bundle.
build_standard_variables_justification: N/A — primary deliverables are a Vite/JS web app and a Python watcher packaged with Inno Setup; no native C/C++ toolchain honoring CC/CFLAGS.
bus_factor_justification: Bus factor is currently 1 (single primary maintainer).
code_of_conduct_justification: No CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md posted in a standard location yet.
code_review_standards_justification: No dedicated CODE_REVIEW.md documenting review checklist beyond CONTRIBUTING/PR process.
coding_standards_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md identifies TypeScript/React patterns, site theme tokens, and ESLint expectations. https://github.com/Sinedrone-Sentinel/dumpers_repo/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
coding_standards_enforced_justification: ESLint enforced in CI (npm run lint) on every PR; merge blocked if lint fails.
contribution_requirements_justification: https://github.com/Sinedrone-Sentinel/dumpers_repo/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md — acceptable contributions: lint/test/build, site theme tokens, no secrets, dumper Conventional Commit scope.
contributors_unassociated_justification: No second unassociated significant contributor meeting Gold’s bar yet (solo primary maintainer).
copyright_per_file_justification: Copyright statements are not included in each source file.
crypto_algorithm_agility_justification: N/A — project is not a crypto library and does not select among algorithm suites beyond platform TLS.
crypto_call_justification: Crypto delegated to platform libraries (browser TLS/Web Crypto, Supabase Auth). No re-implemented ciphers.
crypto_certificate_verification_justific: Browsers and standard HTTPS clients verify certificates by default; app does not disable TLS verification.
crypto_credential_agility_justification: API keys and secrets live in env/GitHub Actions secrets / member settings (dr_… keys), separate from code; rotatable without recompiling the site.
crypto_floss_justification: TLS/Web Crypto in browsers/OS and FLOSS server stacks implement crypto the app depends on.
crypto_keylength_justification: N/A — project does not configure TLS keylengths or generate long-term asymmetric keys; relies on browser/hosting defaults.
crypto_password_storage_justification: N/A — member passwords handled by Supabase Auth (GoTrue), not stored as hashes in this repo’s application code.
crypto_pfs_justification: N/A — project does not implement its own key-agreement; PFS via TLS stacks of browser/hosting.
crypto_published_justification: No custom cryptography. Transport uses published TLS via browsers/hosting/Supabase; Web Crypto (crypto.randomUUID) where needed.
crypto_random_justification: Security-sensitive client IDs/nonces use Web Crypto (crypto.randomUUID), not Math.random.
crypto_tls12_justification: TLS is provided by modern browsers and hosting (Cloudflare/GitHub/Supabase), which support TLS 1.2+.
crypto_used_network_justification: Network communications use HTTPS/TLS (site, Supabase, GitHub). No FTP/telnet/cleartext download channels.
crypto_verification_private_justificatio: Cookies/auth tokens are only sent over HTTPS to the site/Supabase; certificate verification happens before private header exchange in the browser TLS stack.
crypto_weaknesses_justification: Defaults do not rely on SHA-1/CBC-era primitives for security; HTTPS/TLS via modern hosting/browsers.
crypto_working_justification: No application code depends on broken algorithms (MD5/DES/RC4) for security.
dco_justification: No Developer Certificate of Origin / CLA process documented or enforced yet.
delivery_mitm_justification: Site, repository, and GitHub Releases are HTTPS-only.
delivery_unsigned_justification: We do not retrieve cryptographic hashes over plain HTTP for integrity checks. Assets served over HTTPS. (Authenticode/SignPath in progress separately.)
dependency_monitoring_justification: Dependabot weekly for npm, GitHub Actions, and pip (scripts/bp-dumper-py). https://github.com/Sinedrone-Sentinel/dumpers_repo/blob/main/.github/dependabot.yml
description_good_justification: https://www.dumpers-repo.com and README describe Dumper's Repo: Star Citizen blueprint tracking, mining tools, resource coordination, and a member marketplace.
discussion_justification: GitHub Issues and pull requests; in-app Support for members.
documentation_achievements_justification: Site landing and Archive Overview show live OpenSSF Scorecard + Best Practices Baseline badges (TrustBadgeStrip). README also links trust docs.
documentation_architecture_justification: No dedicated high-level architecture document for the software yet (docs cover setup/ops more than design).
documentation_basics_justification: README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/, and in-app Information Archive.
documentation_current_justification: README/CONTRIBUTING/docs and Archive are kept consistent with current behavior as part of normal PR review; known docs defects are fixed when found.
documentation_interface_justification: README / site map document the web UI; BP Dumper docs + docs/SUPABASE_SETUP.md document the dumper/API webhook interface (Authorization: Bearer dr_…).
documentation_quick_start_justification: README quick start / For developers covers clone, env, npm ci, lint/test/build. https://github.com/Sinedrone-Sentinel/dumpers_repo/blob/main/README.md
documentation_roadmap_justification: No documented one-year product roadmap file yet.
documentation_security_justification: SECURITY.md documents what to expect for vulnerability reporting and BP Dumper threat boundaries (no RSI passwords; personal API key). https://github.com/Sinedrone-Sentinel/dumpers_repo/blob/main/SECURITY.md
dynamic_analysis_justification: No routine fuzzer or DAST applied to every major release yet. (Passing SUGGESTED / Gold MUST — intentionally Unmet.)
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: No dedicated dynamic-analysis configuration with assertion-heavy modes yet.
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: N/A — no medium+ vulnerabilities discovered via project dynamic analysis (not routinely applied).
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: N/A — project results are primarily TypeScript/JavaScript and Python, not C/C++.
english_justification: Documentation, UI, and issue/PR discussion are in English.
enhancement_responses_justification: Enhancement requests on GitHub Issues / Support receive a triage response for a majority of requests in the active window.
governance_justification: No GOVERNANCE.md (or equivalent) documenting decision-making model yet. Solo-maintainer BDFL in practice.
hardened_site_justification: public/_headers currently sets limited headers (CORS/cache for a few assets), not a full set of key hardening headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, etc.) on project sites.
hardening_justification: Some operational hardening exists (RLS, least-privilege Actions permissions), but no documented comprehensive hardening header/policy set meeting Silver SHOULD / Gold MUST expectations yet.
implement_secure_design_justification: Secure design applied: RLS + DEFINER RPCs for marketplace, no client privileged profile writes, Discord queue not client-callable, secrets not in VITE_*. See SECURITY.md and supabase security patterns.
input_validation_justification: Untrusted inputs validated at UI and RPC boundaries (allowlists/typed params); invalid inputs rejected by DEFINER RPC checks and client validation.
installation_common_justification: Web app: open dumpers-repo.com or npm run build/preview locally. Dumper Apps: download installer/exe from GitHub Releases (common Windows convention). Documented in README / Dumper Apps UI.
installation_development_quick_justifica: npm ci (+ Playwright chromium for prerender) per CONTRIBUTING/README — standard Node convention to get a working change environment including tests.
installation_standard_variables_justific: N/A — no DESTDIR-style POSIX install system for end-users; Windows installer uses Inno Setup conventions.
interact_justification: Obtain: site + GitHub Releases (Dumper Apps). Feedback: GitHub Issues and in-app Support. Contribute: PR against main (CONTRIBUTING.md).
interfaces_current_justification: Stack kept current via Dependabot and routine upgrades; deprecated APIs avoided where practical in new code.
internationalization_justification: UI and docs are English-only; no i18n/localization framework for end-user strings yet.
know_common_errors_justification: Familiar with XSS/authz bypass/injection/secret leakage for this stack; mitigations include React escaping, RLS + DEFINER RPCs, least-privilege anon key, secrets in Actions/.env, CodeQL.
know_secure_design_justification: Primary developer designs with least privilege and defense-in-depth: anon key in browser; marketplace mutations via SECURITY DEFINER RPCs; privileged columns locked; service_role stays server-side. See SECURITY.md.
license_per_file_justification: SPDX-License-Identifier (or equivalent) not present in each source file.
maintained_justification: Actively maintained; recent commits, PRs, and Dumper Apps releases on GitHub.
maintenance_or_update_justification: Dumper Apps uses SemVer releases with upgrade-by-download from GitHub Releases; site is continuously delivered. Older app versions remain downloadable from Releases history.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: Credentials in GitHub Actions secrets and local .env (gitignored). See SECURITY.md and .gitignore.
osps_ac_01_01_justification: GitHub requires 2FA as of March 2023 for accounts interacting with the authoritative repository.
osps_ac_02_01_justification: GitHub requires the owner/admin to assign each collaborator’s role; new collaborators are not granted admin by default.
osps_ac_03_01_justification: Repository ruleset “Protect main” requires pull requests to main; direct pushes are blocked (including for administrators).
osps_ac_03_02_justification: The same ruleset blocks deletion of main. GitHub also treats default-branch deletion as a confirmed sensitive action.
osps_ac_04_01_justification: Workflows set top-level permissions (typically contents: read) so unspecified job steps inherit least privilege rather than broad defaults. See .github/workflows/ci.yml permissions: contents: read.
osps_ac_04_02_justification: Jobs that need elevated rights declare minimum permissions explicitly (e.g. codeql security-events: write; deploy pages: write; release contents: write). Default workflows stay at contents: read.
osps_br_01_01_justification: GitHub Actions workflows do not pass untrusted PR titles/bodies into shell eval. Jobs use fixed scripts (npm ci, lint/build) and least-privilege GITHUB_TOKEN permissions.
osps_br_01_03_justification: pull_request CI uses read-only permissions and does not access deploy/signing secrets. Privileged secrets are only used on trusted push to main / controlled workflows after merge.
osps_br_01_04_justification: Trusted collaborator workflows use fixed script invocations and do not interpolate untrusted free-text into shells; privileged workflows are limited to push/workflow_dispatch on protected contexts.
osps_br_02_01_justification: Official Dumper Apps releases use unique SemVer tags (vX.Y.Z) via semantic-release / GitHub Releases.
osps_br_02_02_justification: GitHub Release assets are associated with the release tag/identifier (vX.Y.Z) on each official release.
osps_br_03_02_justification: Distribution channels (GitHub Releases, site) use HTTPS exclusively.
osps_br_04_01_justification: GitHub Releases include human-readable changelogs (CHANGELOG / release notes) describing functional changes; security fixes called out when present.
osps_br_05_01_justification: CI/release pipelines ingest dependencies via npm ci / pip from lockfiles/requirements — standardized package tooling.
osps_br_06_01_justification: Official releases are not yet signed / accounted for in a signed manifest with asset hashes (SignPath Authenticode pending; no cosign/SBOM signing yet).
osps_br_07_01_justification: Credentials live in GitHub Actions secrets and local .env files (gitignored). The repo does not commit API keys or service credentials; see SECURITY.md and .gitignore.
osps_br_07_02_justification: No standalone documented secrets/credentials management policy (rotation, storage, access) beyond SECURITY.md / .gitignore practices.
osps_do_01_01_justification: README and in-app Archive provide user guides for basic functionality.
osps_do_03_01_justification: No published end-user instructions yet to verify integrity/authenticity of release assets (pending signing).
osps_do_03_02_justification: No published instructions to verify the expected identity of the release author/process (pending signing provenance).
osps_do_04_01_justification: No descriptive statement of support scope/duration per release.
osps_do_05_01_justification: No descriptive statement of when releases stop receiving security updates.
osps_do_06_01_justification: No dedicated documentation section yet describing how the project selects, obtains, and tracks dependencies (Dependabot exists; prose policy missing).
osps_do_07_01_justification: README/CONTRIBUTING document how to build: Node 22+, npm ci, Playwright chromium, npm run build, plus required env vars.
osps_gv_01_01_justification: No public documentation listing project members with access to sensitive resources (org secrets, Supabase, SignPath).
osps_gv_01_02_justification: No public GOVERNANCE/roles document describing member roles and responsibilities.
osps_gv_02_01_justification: GitHub Issues and pull requests provide public discussion of proposed changes and usage obstacles.
osps_gv_03_01_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md explains the contribution process (PRs to main). https://github.com/Sinedrone-Sentinel/dumpers_repo/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
osps_gv_03_02_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md is a contributor guide that includes requirements for acceptable contributions.
osps_gv_04_01_justification: No written policy that collaborators are reviewed before escalated permissions to sensitive resources.
osps_le_01_01_justification: No DCO/CLA requiring contributors to assert legal authorization on every commit.
osps_le_02_01_justification: Apache-2.0 for repository contents is OSI-approved.
osps_le_02_02_justification: Apache-2.0 for released software assets is OSI-approved. (DFP engine is separate proprietary; not this FLOSS entry’s primary assets.)
osps_le_03_02_justification: LICENSE included in the source repository accompanying releases.
osps_qa_01_02_justification: Git history on GitHub is publicly readable.
osps_qa_02_01_justification: Direct dependencies locked via package-lock.json (npm) and scripts/bp-dumper-py/requirements.txt (Python).
osps_qa_02_02_justification: Compiled release assets (DumperApps.exe) are not yet delivered with an SBOM.
osps_qa_03_01_justification: Required status check lint-and-build must pass (or be explicitly bypassed) before merge to main via repository ruleset.
osps_qa_04_01_justification: N/A — this Best Practices entry covers the dumpers_repo FLOSS project only. Related proprietary DFP code is a separate product, not part of this repository’s codebase list.
osps_qa_04_02_justification: N/A — official releases covered by this entry are produced from this single primary repository, not a multi-repo release set with looser subprojects.
osps_qa_05_01_justification: Build outputs (dist/) and release binaries are not committed; executables published via GitHub Releases only.
osps_qa_05_02_justification: Source tree does not contain opaque compiled binaries. Static assets (images/SVG) are intentional reviewable media.
osps_qa_06_01_justification: CI runs npm test (and lint/build) on pull requests before merge to main.
osps_qa_06_02_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md and CI workflow document when/how tests run (npm test locally and on every PR).
osps_qa_06_03_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md policy: as major new functionality is added, add/extend automated coverage under npm test.
osps_qa_07_01_justification: Repository does not require a non-author human approval on every merge to main (solo maintainer may merge after CI).
osps_sa_01_01_justification: No release design documentation demonstrating all actions and actors within the system.
osps_sa_02_01_justification: External interfaces documented at a basic level: web UI (README/Archive), BP Dumper webhook API (docs/SUPABASE_SETUP.md / dumper docs).
osps_sa_03_01_justification: No published security assessment documenting most likely/impactful problems for a release.
osps_sa_03_02_justification: No published threat modeling / attack surface analysis document for releases.
osps_vm_01_01_justification: SECURITY.md is a CVD-style policy with a clear response timeframe (acknowledge within 7 days).
osps_vm_03_01_justification: SECURITY.md provides private reporting (email / in-app Support) to security contacts.
osps_vm_04_01_justification: No public vulnerability disclosure / advisories dataset published yet (none to date; process for publishing not documented beyond SECURITY.md).
osps_vm_04_02_justification: No VEX documents published for component vulnerabilities judged non-exploitable.
osps_vm_05_01_justification: No documented SCA remediation threshold policy for vulnerabilities/licenses.
osps_vm_05_02_justification: No documented policy requiring SCA violations to be addressed prior to every release.
osps_vm_05_03_justification: Dependency changes are not automatically blocked by a documented malicious/known-vuln policy gate (Dependabot alerts exist; no merge-blocking SCA policy).
osps_vm_06_01_justification: No documented SAST remediation threshold policy.
osps_vm_06_02_justification: CodeQL runs on PRs but findings are not automatically merge-blocked by a documented SAST policy exception process.
regression_tests_added50_justification: No measured evidence that >=50% of bugs fixed in the last six months received regression tests.
release_notes_justification: Human-readable notes on GitHub Releases + scripts/bp-dumper/CHANGELOG.md. https://github.com/Sinedrone-Sentinel/dumpers_repo/releases
release_notes_vulns_justification: No publicly known CVE-assigned run-time vulnerabilities fixed in releases to date.
repo_interim_justification: Full git history with ongoing commits/PRs between releases.
repo_track_justification: Git on GitHub tracks who changed what and when.
report_responses_justification: Bug reports via GitHub Issues and in-app Support are acknowledged (triaged) by the maintainer; a majority of reports in the active window receive a response even when a fix is not immediate.
report_tracker_justification: GitHub Issues: https://github.com/Sinedrone-Sentinel/dumpers_repo/issues — also in-app Support on dumpers-repo.com.
require_2FA_justification: GitHub requires 2FA for the organization/account accessing the central repository (GitHub org 2FA enforcement as of 2023+).
roles_responsibilities_justification: Key roles/responsibilities not yet publicly documented in a governance file (solo maintainer: Sinedrone-Sentinel).
secure_2FA_justification: Maintainer 2FA uses authenticator-app / cryptographic second factor via GitHub (not SMS-only).
security_review_justification: No formal documented security review within the last 5 years meeting this criterion’s assurance-case-style bar (ad hoc hardening and migrations exist, but not a published review).
signed_releases_justification: Authenticode signing via SignPath is applied-for / not yet live (SIGNPATH_SIGNING_LIVE=false). No documented public verify process for signed release assets yet.
sites_https_justification: Project website, GitHub repository, and GitHub Releases download URLs use HTTPS.
sites_password_security_justification: N/A for GitHub/repo/download URLs (no password stores there). Member site auth passwords are stored by Supabase Auth (GoTrue) with industry-standard hashing, not by custom app code in this repo.
small_tasks_justification: No curated “good first issue” / small-tasks list published for new contributors yet.
static_analysis_justification: CodeQL on push/PR for javascript-typescript, python, and actions. https://github.com/Sinedrone-Sentinel/dumpers_repo/blob/main/.github/workflows/codeql.yml
static_analysis_fixed_justification: Medium+ exploitable CodeQL findings fixed or dismissed with justification in a timely way.
static_analysis_often_justification: CodeQL on every push to main and every PR, plus weekly schedule.
test_justification: npm test (unit + mining math) documented in CONTRIBUTING + README; CI runs it.
test_most_justification: SUGGESTED: suite covers mining math and selected unit helpers; not most SPA branches/UI paths.
test_policy_mandated_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md states that as major new functionality is added, tests should be added to npm test; CI must stay green.
test_statement_coverage80_justification: No measured >=80% statement coverage with a FLOSS coverage tool published for the SPA.
tests_are_added_justification: Recent major quality work added npm test (scripts/tests/ + verify-mining-math) and wired it into CI per CONTRIBUTING policy.
two_person_review_justification: Solo maintainer may merge own PRs after CI green; not >=50% reviewed by a different person before release.
updateable_reused_components_justificati: Dependencies managed via npm/package-lock and pip requirements; Dependabot PRs make updates easy.
version_semver_justification: Semantic Versioning for Dumper Apps tags (vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH).
version_tags_signed_justification: Release git tags are not cryptographically signed (GPG/SSH signed tags) today.
version_unique_justification: Dumper Apps releases use unique SemVer tags (vX.Y.Z) via semantic-release / GitHub Releases.
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: Critical issues prioritized for rapid fix after confirmation; none left open as known critical unpatched in project results.
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: No medium-or-higher publicly known vulnerabilities in project results unpatched >60 days. Dependabot + CodeQL monitoring.
vulnerability_report_credit_justificatio: N/A — no vulnerability reports resolved in the last 12 months to credit.
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: SECURITY.md requires private reporting (maintainer email or in-app Support marked security). https://github.com/Sinedrone-Sentinel/dumpers_repo/blob/main/SECURITY.md
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: N/A — no private vulnerability reports received in the last 6 months. SECURITY.md commits to acknowledge within 7 days (<=14 days) when reports arrive.
vulnerability_response_process_justifica: Documented in SECURITY.md (private report, 7-day acknowledge aim, coordinated disclosure). https://github.com/Sinedrone-Sentinel/dumpers_repo/blob/main/SECURITY.md
warnings_justification: ESLint (npm run lint); CI fails PRs on lint failure.
warnings_fixed_justification: Required CI check lint-and-build blocks merge when ESLint fails.
warnings_strict_justification: CI treats ESLint failures as hard errors (merge blocked).
